notes.title: About the official version of "DawnBreak"--Trial Version Retirement Notice
notes.content: [h1]Trial Version Retirement Notice[/h1][p]The trial version has been available for two months, and numerous bug fixes and optimizations have been implemented. However, some issues remain. Further updates will hinder development of the full version, so we have decided to temporarily suspend the trial version. Thank you for your understanding![/p][p][/p][h1]About the official version of "DawnBreak"[/h1][p]Currently completed:[/p][list][*][p]4 Challenge Modes[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Story Mode 75%-90% complete[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Apartment Mode 70% complete (development will begin after Story Mode and Challenge Mode are completed)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The official release will likely be delayed until Q4 2025.[/p][/*][/list][h2]About Apartment Mode:[/h2][p][b][i]This is a planned feature, so the actual details may vary![/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjust your face and body shape in the apartment mirror (Completed)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bathroom, yoga, dance,computer access (Completed)[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] fitness, pets, flying chess, Virtual Anchor, apartment renovation, and other interactive features (Planned content; will be completed before release or added as an update after release)[/p][p]                           [/p][p]                                Development progress updated on 2025.09.18[/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]Thank you to the approximately 20,000 players who wishlisted the game (thanks to all the players who participated in the trial, the streamers who participated in the trial, and the players who provided feedback and suggestions).[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: 2025.07.10 Dawn Break Trial Update
notes.content: [p]-Game size reduced by 2.3G, 15.7G->13.4G[/p][p]-Press the run button while crouching to automatically leave the crouch[/p][p]-When aiming, the weapon will be retracted when hitting a wall, and it will no longer be retracted when hitting an enemy[/p][p]-Silenced pistol also adds a flashlight[/p][p]-Fixed the oxygen value after interacting with items[/p][p]-Immune to grenade damage when interacting with items[/p][p]-Interacting with items will no longer retract the weapon (interactive text in the scene)[/p][p]-Optimize textures and lod, optimize performance.[/p][p]-Key input of the password lock is synchronized with the player's custom input[/p][p]-The duration of the cutscene when entering the nightmare is reduced[/p][p]-Fixed the small probability of weapon model disappearing[/p][p]-Fixed the bug that the weapon will remain in the gun position when being knocked down when switching guns[/p][p]-Fixed the character shaking when retracting the weapon[/p][p]-Removed the camera shaking when switching guns[/p][p]-Fixed the bug that the empty-handed stop animation will be played when the weapon is stopped and retracted after moving with a gun[/p][p]-Reduced the long-press purchase time in the store[/p][p]-Added a video tutorial on unlocking equipment skills in the skill world[/p]

notes.title: 2025.07.01 Dawn Breaking Trial Update Content
notes.content: [p]New movement system, smoother movement system when using empty hands.[/p][p]Two movement systems can be selected in the menu.[/p][p]The first one, the character always faces forward[/p][p]The second one, the character faces freely, you can freely view the character while running.[/p][p]Optimize small object physical collision[/p][p]Fix the bug that cannot jump after rolling[/p][p]Optimize jump turning[/p][p]Smoother climbing action, fix the jitter at the end of climbing[/p][p]Optimize throwing function[/p][p]Remove the keyboard Z key and the handle dual joystick, and restore the perspective when pressing[/p][p]Fix the character's feet sinking into the ground after using the ladder[/p][p]Modify the pistol aiming perspective and reduce the head shaking when shooting[/p][p]Optimize dodge, increase the dodge distance, and be immune to enemy damage when dodging (except grenades)[/p][p]The menu can be opened during the cutscene, and a small part is not available for the time being.[/p][p]When looting a box with a weapon, the weapon will no longer be automatically put away. When using medicine while holding a weapon, the weapon will no longer be automatically put away. The time from death to rebirth is shortened by 3 seconds. A reminder sound and icon are added when medicine cannot be used. The whole text is retranslated. Lights are added in the large warehouse. A cursor is added to the position of the butler's mobile phone by the river in the valley.[/p]

notes.title: 2025.06.21 Dawn Break Trial Update Content
notes.content: [p]-Removed the delay of switching guns[/p][p]-Fixed the occasional no recoil bug[/p][p]-Fixed the strange posture when switching guns instantly when aiming in a non-frontal direction[/p][p]-Modified and optimized the jumping animation[/p][p]-Fixed the bug that after opening the challenge mode, opening the story mode will enter the challenge mode[/p][p]-The name display on the sign of the Electronic Dog Company in Chapter 2 is missing[/p][p]-Fixed the translation of assassination[/p][p]-The head and body colors of some costumes are wrong[/p][p]-The buttons fail to work when the death close-up is interrupted[/p][p]-Some translation errors[/p][p]-The guide cursor does not display when returning to the power distribution room to find parts[/p][p]-Fixed the small probability that the enemy will play a weird animation instead of the execution animation when executing the enemy[/p][p]-The ladder in the power distribution room is disabled to accelerate down the ladder[/p][p]-Disable medicine when using the ladder[/p][p]-Reduce the price of store clothing[/p]

notes.title: 17.06.2025 Dawn Break Trial Update Content
notes.content: [p]-Added difficulty system[/p][p]-Fixed the stagger caused by the falling animation triggered by the stone crack[/p][p]-Fixed the interruption of the aiming by the small stone crack[/p][p]-Melee can now attack shorter enemies[/p][p]-The arm of the crawler's standing up animation and the death animation when fainting is through the model[/p][p]-Challenge mode casual and normal difficulty enemy damage will be lower, other difficulties remain unchanged (Note! This difficulty needs to be modified on the computer in challenge mode)[/p][p]-Challenge mode clearance reward is changed to randomly get 50~100 coins, instead of an empty pair of sunglasses 2.[/p][p]-Challenge mode UI adaptation, fix the display missing caused by different monitor ratios.[/p][p]-When there is water near the stairs, go down the stairs and escape into the void[/p][p]-When leaving the stairs underwater, quickly press forward and you will get stuck in the wall, or get stuck in the middle of the stairs and cannot move[/p][p]-Now reading a note in the water does not consume oxygen[/p][p]-Fixed the bug of falling into the water and getting stuck in the floor[/p][p]-Pop up usage tips near the stairs[/p]

notes.title: 14.06.2025 Dawn Breaking Trial Update
notes.content: [p]-Added twin ponytail hairstyle for zombie girls in the store[/p][p]-Added cursor guidance to the password position of the first access room[/p][p]-Clicking the handle menu too quickly will not return[/p][p]-Walking to the right front, the arm is inserted[/p][p]-Removed the other two crystals on the gloves in the nightmare level crystal[/p][p]-Fixed the disappearance of stockings when the clothes are damaged[/p][p]-Added lootable boxes in the scene[/p][p]-Adapted UI, fixed the incomplete UI display caused by different monitor ratios[/p][p]-After deleting the save file, re-entering the plot will start from the prologue instead of the first chapter.[/p][p]-Fixed the short press to switch between walking and running[/p]

notes.title: Update content on 12.06.2025
notes.content: [p]The HP of the monster in the last elevator of the Electronic Dog Company has been reduced[/p][p]The HP of the enemies in the valley has been adjusted[/p][p]The HP of a human soldier in the Electronic Dog Company is too high[/p][p]Optimize the guidance of the Electronic Dog Company[/p][p]Shotgun optimization (more dense bullets)[/p][p]The Electronic Dog Company saves and continues the game after a bug[/p][p]Change the store purchase to long press purchase[/p][p]Reduce the camera shake during execution[/p][p]Pop up the quick weapon switching button when equipping a weapon (keyboard only)[/p][p]Fix the bug of the short skirt school uniform, because the cloth effect of the Unreal Engine clothing will cause the deformation target of the clothing to be invalid, and the deformation target of the character's body is valid, causing the model to be penetrated.[/p][p]Add special effects to the items dropped by the enemy[/p][p]Long press to pick up items is changed to short press to pick up[/p][p]Fix the problem that the custom button is invalid for horizontal movement[/p][p]Switching clothing accessories causes the stockings to disappear[/p][p]Running can be set to long press or switch[/p][p]Disable input during cutscenes to prevent the menu from being stuck in the wall[/p][p]Shooting with a shotgun at the moment of being knocked down will interrupt the knockdown animation, causing the character to be unable to move.[/p][p]Increased brightness inside the valley scene.[/p][p]Triggered execution at a steep position or on the edge of a cliff, causing the player's buttons to fail.[/p][p]When the enemy controls the player, there is a small chance that the player's buttons will fail.[/p][p]Dodge diagonally at a longer distance.[/p][p]Added suicide function in the menu (to escape from stuck state).[/p][p]Guide to picking up gloves and scene interactions in the valley.[/p]

notes.title: 10.06.2025 Update Content
notes.content: [h1]-All 4 costumes of the exclusive reward of the main menu trial version have been unlocked. If you have cleared the story mode, you can claim them all[/h1][p]-dx12 has been changed to dx11, the frame rate has increased by 40~60, and it is more stable and compatible with old devices.[/p][p]-Cannot claim the first trial version reward[/p][p]-The resurrection of the first chapter valley is stuck[/p][p]-The computer control room and store UI are displayed at the same time[/p][p]-Remove the q key[/p][p]-Electric Dog Company brand translation[/p][p]-Owned skill points translation in the skill interface[/p][p]-Remove the computer in the employee lounge cannot interact with the folder[/p][p]-Key prompts when swimming[/p][p]-The damage caused by the enemy is reduced by 30%~40%[/p][p]-Regarding the password of the large warehouse, change the check employee lounge in the upper left corner to check the password on the table in the employee lounge[/p][p]-Add cursor guidance for finding parts, and refine the cursor guidance of the electronic dog office game.[/p][p]-Human enemies will die directly if they are headshot, and will no longer kneel[/p][p]If there are still bugs, please feel free to give me feedback! I will reply to every player.[/p]

notes.title: 09.06.2025 Dawn Breaking Trial Update
notes.content: [p]-Fixed the crash or freeze caused by the number key 567[/p][p]-Fixed the quantum gloves that will be cut through when wearing a bikini swimsuit[/p][p]-Fixed the hair box in the first chapter of the valley showing earrings[/p][p]-Fixed the abnormal lighting in the valley in the first chapter[/p][p]-Falling in the valley in the first chapter will cause death[/p][p]-Skip the cutscene and the game cannot continue[/p][p]-After reading the archive, the parts room cannot take the parts[/p][p]-Modify the character's standing arms[/p][p]-Optimize the change of clothes crash[/p][p]-Optimize the hit crash[/p][p]Regarding the game crash, I found that dx12 is 50fps lower than dx11 during the test, and dx11 is more compatible and stable. I am fixing this problem. Thank you for your trial. If you have any questions, please feel free to ask and I will reply in time![/p]
